## Purpose
Card section that lists GitHub repositories with name, description, stars, forks and language colour, plus a See All link to the user's repository page. It renders `limit` skeleton tiles while loading and is used by the page in [[src-components]].

## Key concepts
- `GithubProjectCard({header, githubProjects, loading, limit, username, googleAnalyticsId})`.
- `GithubProject` type from [[src-interfaces]]; `getLanguageColor`, `ga`, `skeleton` from [[src-utils]].
- Click tiles fire `ga.event('Click project')` when an analytics id is set, then open `html_url` in a new tab.

## Gotchas
- Returns early with no output when not loading and the project list is empty (the whole section disappears).
- Early return occurs before the render helpers are defined; it returns `undefined`, not `null`.
